about_the_game:
In the realm of Antara, four mighty nations—Fire, Earth, Water, and Air—once thrived in harmony under the guidance of the legendary Book of Elements. That balance was shattered when Norbakh, a shadow from the multiverse, tore the world into chaos. Now the fate of Antara rests in your hands.

Fate of Antara is a story-driven single-player RPG that blends rich fantasy world-building with fast-paced, ant-inspired powers. As a hero chosen from among the nations, you’ll journey through vast forests, mountains, and caverns, unite divided kingdoms, and confront Norbakh’s dark forces in epic battles.

✨ Key Features

  • Four Elemental Nations – Command the unique strengths of Fire, Earth, Water, and Air ants, each with distinct abilities and playstyles.

  • Heroic Ant Abilities – Wall-crawl across terrain, sense vibrations, command pheromone swarms, spray acid, and unleash other insect-inspired powers.

  • Epic Storyline – Follow the prophecy of the Book of Elements through betrayal, unity, and the climactic war against Norbakh’s corruption.

  • Strategic Combat & Exploration – Combine agility, resilience, and swarm coordination to overcome enemies while uncovering hidden paths and resources.

  • Immersive World – Explore enchanted forests, treacherous mountains, deep oceans, and turbulent skies brought to life with rich detail and visuals.

content_descriptors.notes:
Fate of Antara contains fantasy combat between ant-like nations. Battles feature the use of magical abilities, melee weapons, and elemental powers (fire, water, earth, and air).

There is no gore, blood, sexual content, drug use, or self-harm. The mature themes are limited to fantasy violence and conflict between nations, which may not be suitable for very young players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-8350 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 (4GB VRAM) / AMD Radeon R9 380 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 11 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: playable at 1080p on medium settings, ~30 FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti / RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600 XT (6GB VRAM or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card with surround support
  • Additional Notes: Best at 1080p/1440p, Ultra settings, 60+ FPS.
